es.team.name: Cobranza
es.team.for: Negocios con clientes que pagan tarde y facturas vencidas que nadie persigue.
es.team.solves: Saber quién te debe, recordárselo a tiempo y cuidar la relación mientras se cobra.
es.agent.accounting: Lleva la lista de facturas vencidas y prepara los recordatorios de pago.
es.agent.sales: Habla con los clientes que deben para acordar fechas sin enfriar la relación.
es.agent.assistant: Reúne cada mañana lo que vence hoy y lo que quedó sin respuesta.
es.week.collections: Revisa las cuentas vencidas y prepara los primeros recordatorios.
es.week.customer_complaint: Atiende a quien dice que no debe o que la factura está mal, antes de insistir.
es.week.daily_briefing: Deja un resumen diario de lo cobrado y lo que sigue pendiente.

en.team.name: Collections
en.team.for: Businesses whose customers pay late and whose overdue invoices nobody chases.
en.team.solves: Know who owes you, remind them in time and look after the relationship while you collect.
en.agent.accounting: Keeps the list of overdue invoices and prepares the payment reminders.
en.agent.sales: Talks to customers who owe to agree on dates without cooling the relationship.
en.agent.assistant: Gathers every morning what is due today and what went unanswered.
en.week.collections: Reviews overdue accounts and prepares the first reminders.
en.week.customer_complaint: Handles whoever says they do not owe or that the invoice is wrong, before pushing again.
en.week.daily_briefing: Leaves a daily summary of what was collected and what is still open.
